_note: PROBE for person.wounded (plan OT-9A): MB85a's talk, word for word so every voiced line is already in the voice cache, with Bram lying wounded in vanilla's NPCWoundedLean (OE_BryanB_FamilyInNeed's shape).

What a play answers: (1) is he down in the wounded pose at the marker; (2) can he be talked to while down (the entry stage sets SQ_CaptiveStateNoBlockingHellos, as BrotherInNeed's stage 0 does); (3) does [Give Med Pack] take one and end the talk; (4) does HealActor stand him up, with vanilla's thanks line; (5) does a stock Help or Free prompt show on him at all, and what does it do.
The Papyrus log carries a [wounded] line on the heal stage with IsRestrained read back. Pay easy.

beats.objective: PROBE w1: treat the wounded miner at the <Place>

person.name: Bram Kessler
hellos: If you're from the clinic, I'm fine.

greeting: Don't fuss. It's a scratch. A big scratch. Did they send you with a med pack?

exchanges.prompt: Here's a med pack. Hold still.
reply: Ow. Right. Thank you. I'd have walked in eventually. Probably.
Arguing with a drill. The drill won.

broadcast: The patient's a miner who won't come in. Bring a med pack and be patient with him. More patient than he is.
